title: Leaving out the leavening

evidence.basis: B2, an outcome-preservation policy: the effect of leaving it out is sourced (ATK SRC-LV-02#a 'Without leaveners, baked goods would be dense and squat'; Bob's Red Mill; ASBE), the refusal is the owner's judgement (D-7). OD-7 (owner commission 2026-10-08, ENGINEERING only; not culinary validation, not released guidance). Evidence: private/research/substitution-knowledge (2026-10-07). Scope: the only leavener, whisked into the dry mix (COMBINE_DRY); another leavening source in the recipe leaves it out of scope, an unconfirmed ingredient leaves it unknown.

text: Leaving the leavening out with nothing in its place isn't offered: it's what makes this dough rise, and without it the result bakes dense and squat instead of the recipe's intended rise.
scopeNote: This keeps the recipe's intended result; it isn't a claim that nothing can be baked without it. Replacements are answered separately.
